title: Piwigo plugin manifest
description: Declarative manifest for Piwigo 17+ plugins. One file per plugin at plugins/<id>/plugin.json. Read by PluginRegistry at load time; validated via opis/json-schema.

$schema.description: URI pointing at this schema for IDE/editor autocomplete. Optional; not enforced.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must match the plugin directory basename.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the admin UI.

version.description: Plugin version — SemVer or PEM-revision-string (e.g. '1.4.0', '2.0', '1.0.0-beta.1', '1.0+r42'). Up to 4 dot-separated numeric segments — see theme.schema.json's own version field for why.

description.description: Single-line description shown in the admin UI.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. 'GPL-3.0-or-later', 'MIT', 'Apache-2.0'). Required — this fork rejects plugins distributed without a license.

minPiwigo.description: Minimum Piwigo version this plugin targets, matching Core\AppInfo::VERSION's own 3-part shape (e.g. '16.3.0') — NOT a 'MAJOR.MINOR' branch marker. This fork deliberately pins AppInfo::VERSION to the legacy PHPWG_VERSION data-format value rather than a 17.x branch marker (bumping it forward once caused a real upgrade-redirect-loop bug), so PluginRegistry compares this field directly against AppInfo::VERSION via composer/semver, matching PemCatalog's own established precedent for extension-compatibility checks.

hasSettings.description: Whether the plugin exposes a settings page: true (admin), false (none), or 'webmaster' (webmaster-only). Default: false.

hasApiRoutes.description: Whether the plugin registers its own /api/v1/plugin-routes/{id}/... REST routes via ApiRouteProviderInterface. Default: false.

hasAdminPages.description: Whether the plugin contributes its own admin.php ?page= slug(s) via AdminPageProviderInterface. Default: false.

hasPageRoutes.description: Whether the plugin registers its own public-facing page routes (e.g. a clean-URL entry point like the legacy tag_groups.php) via PageRouteProviderInterface. Default: false.

require.description: Map of dependency names to composer-style version constraints. Keys are 'piwigo' for core or 'plugin/<id>' for another plugin.

psr-4.description: PSR-4 namespace prefix to directory map, relative to the plugin root.

autoload.description: Autoload configuration for the plugin's source files.
